title: Ferryx browser-agent QA host config
description: One QA host for scripts/qa/browser-agent/run.mjs (plan maho-browser-merge, Concrete QA contract). Validated before anything is launched. Never put production credentials or the real user data directory here.

os.description: OS label used as the evidence directory name: <evidence>/<os>/<Q>/.

hostLabel.description: Free-form host name recorded in receipts (e.g. omarchy, maho-win).

gui.description: Candidate GUI executable paths, in preference order; the first existing one is used.

cli.description: Candidate `ferryx` CLI executable paths, in preference order.

isolation.description: Isolated roots owned by this run; must be absolute and pairwise distinct. The harness never touches the real profile or HOME.

mahord.description: MahoRD endpoint driving the native GUI (scripts/qa/daemon-lifetime/lib/mahord.mjs).

binary.description: maho-client executable; defaults to `maho-client` on PATH.

remoteGateway.description: Existing remote gateway bootstrap for the QA (non-production) device used by Q2/Q4/Q8/Q9.

url.description: Gateway base URL of the isolated QA instance.

bootstrapFile.description: Path to the QA device bootstrap/pairing material produced for this run (not production auth).

remoteControlPageUrl.description: Remote control page used for the Q9 390x844 consent checks.

engine.description: Browser engine under test. 'webview' = the system webview (FERRYX_CEF_ENGINE_DIR unset); 'chromium' = the CEF engine from engineDir (passed to the app as FERRYX_CEF_ENGINE_DIR). Evidence goes to <evidence>/<os>-<engine>/<Q>/.

engineDir.description: Chromium engine directory (contains ferryx_engine); required when engine is chromium.

consentCard.description: Screen position of the consent card's Allow/Approve button on this host.

revokeGrant.description: The first grant's Revoke access button, with Settings > Browser already open on Agent access.
